Cours du mercredi 7 octobre 2026. Les matières et les mots de l'emploi du temps. Comme dans les leçons 1 et 2, apprends le mot et son explication en anglais. Word — Meaning — En français School subjects — English, science, French, etc. are school subjects. — les matières scolaires A school timetable — A school programme. — un emploi du temps To attend class — To participate in class sessions. — assister au cours, aller en classe A period — A moment of time. Ex: the morning, the afternoon.

notions.titre: Les matières de ton cahier, en anglais
notions.texte: Subject — En français English — l'anglais French — le français Spanish — l'espagnol Maths — les mathématiques Physics — la physique (physique-chimie) Biology / Science — la biologie, les sciences (SVT) History — l'histoire Drawing — le dessin Physical training — l'EPS En anglais, le nom des matières de langue prend une majuscule : English, French, Spanish. Ton cahier écrit aussi History avec une majuscule.

I look at my school timetable every morning. We attend class in the morning. In the drawing lesson, I colour pictures. During the free period, we eat our breakfast. In physical training, we run and play football.
Chaque ligne a un bouton 🔊. Attention à timetable : le premier « i » se dit « aï » (« taïm-téï-beul »). Et period se dit « pi-ri-eud ».
Donner son avis (son opinion) sur une matière : dire si on la trouve facile, difficile, ennuyeuse, intéressante…

How do you find …? What do you think about …? What's your opinion about …? Les trois veulent dire la même chose : « Comment trouves-tu … ? / Qu'est-ce que tu penses de … ? / Quel est ton avis sur … ? ». What's = What is.
A: How do you find English? B: I find English easy. A: What do you think about History lessons? B: I think History lessons are nice.

quiz.question: A school timetable is…
quiz.explication: A school timetable = a school programme (un emploi du temps).

quiz.question: To attend class means…
quiz.explication: To attend class = to participate in class sessions (aller en cours).

quiz.question: A free period is…
quiz.explication: A free period = a break time: breakfast time, lunch time.

quiz.question: Physical training means…
quiz.explication: Physical training = sports (l'EPS).

quiz.question: In a drawing lesson, students…
quiz.explication: A drawing lesson: a lesson of arts and pictures when students paint or colour pictures.

quiz.question: Spelling lessons are…
quiz.explication: Spelling lessons: oral and pronunciation lessons.

quiz.question: Comment dit-on « un moment de la journée (le matin, l'après-midi) » ?
quiz.explication: A period = a moment of time. Ex: the morning, the afternoon.

quiz.question: Complete: How do you ___ English?
quiz.explication: How do you find English? — I find English easy.

quiz.question: Complete: What do you think ___ History lessons?
quiz.explication: What do you think about…? (Qu'est-ce que tu penses de… ?)

quiz.question: Quelle réponse est CORRECTE ?
options: I think History lessons is nice.
I think History lessons are nice.
I thinking History lessons are nice.
quiz.reponse: I think History lessons are nice.
quiz.explication: History lessons est au pluriel → are. Avec think, il faut is ou are.

quiz.question: « What's your opinion about maths? » means the same as…
options: What do you think about maths?
quiz.reponse: What do you think about maths?
quiz.explication: What's your opinion about…? = What do you think about…? = How do you find…?

quiz.question: Complete: I find English ___.
quiz.explication: I find + matière + adjectif : I find English easy (pas de is).

quiz.question: A mark = …
quiz.explication: A mark = a grade (une note). Ex: 13/20 after a test.

quiz.question: A schedule = …
quiz.explication: A schedule = a timetable: a school programme.

quiz.question: I always have good grades in English. I'm ___ English.
quiz.explication: To be good at = to have good marks at. On dit good AT, pas good in.

quiz.question: To be bad at means…
quiz.explication: To be bad at = to have bad marks at.

quiz.question: Which one is a scientific subject?
quiz.explication: Scientific subjects: maths, physics, biology, science.

quiz.question: Which one is a literary subject?
quiz.explication: Literary subjects: English, French, Spanish.

quiz.question: A favourite subject is…
options: a subject you like the most
quiz.reponse: a subject you like the most
quiz.explication: A favourite subject: a subject you like the most. English is my favourite subject.

quiz.question: Complete: We have English ___ 9:20 ___ 10:15.
quiz.explication: From … to … : l'heure du début et l'heure de la fin.
